caseNameFull: Abo Land Company v. Roman Tenorio, Sheriff, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of New Mexico.
attorneys: Mr. Bernard S. Rodey and Mr. Pearce C. Rodey for plaintiff in error. No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. § 237, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
